why: Both moved the same four chat.completions sites with the same two Router-shape fixes and comparable live proof, so the decision falls on the system-level work: A's six improvements are tailored per call site — cheap model only where output is invisible (summarisation), the newer-and-cheaper frontier model for user-facing chat, vision held back as its own yes/no because of the reasoning-token-vs-300-cap risk, timeouts tiered and separated from vendor changes — plus two measured dead-ends that would have cost a less careful team money. B's judgment is thinner and partly self-contradicting: one blanket model_map over all four sites, applied to the vision site whose own evidence shows the chosen model inventing 'a person wearing a face mask' in a solid red image, and a safety lever (provider_timeout) bundled into the fallback item so the two can't be approved separately.
A_best: Per-call-site ranking backed by measurement: summarisation to gpt-4o-mini (-94%, nobody reads it), chat/plugin to gpt-5.1 (cheaper AND terser, with the Flex-on-buffered-calls trap caught and the service_tier pin given), vision split out as its own decision, and the n1 note proving gpt-4o-mini bills 8,522 image tokens where gpt-4o bills 277 — killing the obvious-but-wrong cheap-vision swap.
B_best: Found a third real break neither wrapping nor testing against OpenAI would reveal — every uploaded photo is PNG but announced as image/jpeg, which OpenAI sniffs past and Anthropic 400s — fixed it, made the cross-vendor item depend on it, and separately discovered by simulating an outage through the app that a fallback model's pre-tool-call preamble silently kills the streamed plugin loop.
A_worst: i6 lists claude-haiku-4-5 as the vision fallback while never finding the jpeg/PNG mislabel, so the vision half of that fallback would 400 exactly when it is needed; and i1's headline '-47%' is largely OpenAI's automatic prefix caching, which A's own loses admits the key did not create.
B_worst: The central lever is a quality downgrade (gpt-4o to gpt-4.1-mini, or a vendor switch to Claude) applied uniformly to the user-facing reply, the plugin follow-up, vision and the summariser alike — no item cheapens the invisible summarisation while protecting the reply, and vision is swapped despite B's own measurement that the candidate misreads images.
